", "source_child_index": 3076}, {"id": "fr42c-035-0061", "tag": "p", "role": "AUTHORIAL_PROSE", "text": "— Quoi ! cette influence se fait réellement sentir ? demanda lady Glenarvan.", "sha256": "ca5c90c6609c8805b4aabadace206541f0dc28ae8b08feae5ef168dc3da61eb6", "source_html": "

", "source_child_index": 3077}, {"id": "fr42c-035-0062", "tag": "p", "role": "AUTHORIAL_PROSE", "text": "— Oui, Madame, sur les animaux et les hommes.", "sha256": "80a1c69950679e56b7f61bd7d05438afbf0af11beb5c83bc2139ea4e3ced4d8d", "source_html": "

", "source_child_index": 3078}, {"id": "fr42c-035-0063", "tag": "p", "role": "AUTHORIAL_PROSE", "text": "— Vous ne plaisantez pas, monsieur Paganel ?", "sha256": "33d8a7f91264e996e7931199951f3b0d271e067b4fa813ed95326df4ab53e973", "source_html": "

", "source_child_index": 3079}, {"id": "fr42c-035-0064", "tag": "p", "role": "AUTHORIAL_PROSE", "text": "— Je ne plaisante pas. Les chevaux et les bestiaux y sont d’une docilité remarquable. ", "source_child_index": 3082}, {"id": "fr42c-035-0067", "tag": "p", "role": "AUTHORIAL_PROSE", "text": "— Mais alors, vous, monsieur Paganel, vous qui êtes déjà si bon, dit lady Helena, qu’allez-vous devenir sur cette terre privilégiée ?", "sha256": "c6b6901a0697e812fe9ecd54dd2d206566a1f9b94de89d1a1350513a5e1eb22c", "source_html": "

", "source_child_index": 3083}, {"id": "fr42c-035-0068", "tag": "p", "role": "AUTHORIAL_PROSE", "text": "— Excellent, Madame, répondit Paganel, tout simplement excellent ! »", "sha256": "cb9f8e3733533c24a0d97614d1e99749281a11d2e23b47cf70a1f98466a466fb", "source_html": "

В Австралии все люди становятся лучше.", "source_sha256": "4f9307988a93fe46843cd975886daf6799fe09841caa4645c15f9189f4b2ad23", "target_id": "ru-fr42c-035-0066", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "920c40953eac90ed06d19aa4be73cb11f56011232ea33f88bcb32c41a1fd31fb"}, {"source_id": "fr42c-035-0067", "target": "— Но тогда, вы, месье Паганель, вы, который и так уже столь добр, — сказала леди Елена, — кем же вы станете на этой избранной земле?", "source_sha256": "c6b6901a0697e812fe9ecd54dd2d206566a1f9b94de89d1a1350513a5e1eb22c", "target_id": "ru-fr42c-035-0067", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "d82b0ea531e60fc9f0d82f35c63afda4279402d27fc367f33c4089ab97987c3c"}, {"source_id": "fr42c-035-0068", "target": "— Превосходно, мадам, — ответил Паганель, — просто превосходно!»", "source_sha256": "cb9f8e3733533c24a0d97614d1e99749281a11d2e23b47cf70a1f98466a466fb", "target_id": "ru-fr42c-035-0068", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "9a4ab66f1446ce769880f809566164893097b11f364bd8090732b86b26911f28"}, {"source_id": "fr42c-note-072", "target": "24 лиев.", "source_sha256": "e7dfe26530eb17a15516d3e40b2f413658757b198cdd0bf6c19e13f9b8340010", "target_id": "ru-fr42c-note-072", "tag": "note", "target_sha256": "44f909ba0662da0f8c9ef43887534aef2f78a8d054af9cd4ad85bfdcb402b261"}, {"source_id": "fr42c-note-073", "target": "От английского глагола «to squat» — садиться.", "source_sha256": "f6c1589edc1eaddeada22c86358623dd3f756cf72ca80806e78a756f263109fc", "target_id": "ru-fr42c-note-073", "tag": "note", "target_sha256": "ba5c8e48908b543c11567b306525fc43707a71dad034fe006acbfb62eec2511e"}, {"source_id": "fr42c-note-074", "target": "Ла Плант.", "source_sha256": "7e1bb3baf6b22408b1df10def50d2338a47d5728ccfc5c72f04a81bedf97c086", "target_id": "ru-fr42c-note-074", "tag": "note", "target_sha256": "87c5ba1624b98fe3089ea93f978c9091f087a9f16190aa99d9590f9b31bf4f43"}]}
